scientific_queries.note: Annotation-resource audit plus a target-conditional test on data in hand.

subagent_note: None dispatched. The positive signal rests on only two layout clusters and is reported as hypothesis-generating; a challenger would be needed before any confirmation wording.

compute.runs: e018b 4x (reference-file fix, layout-key fix, newline syntax fix, final)

annotation_correction.previous: F6 said the target reference is unavailable (moa covers 2 of 23 compounds)
annotation_correction.corrected: BATCHIE drug name -> PubChem ID -> ENSG genes via the two local MAPKG tables covers 61 of 90 analysed compounds (67.8%); 297 of 659 compound pairs are both-annotated and 54 share at least one gene
annotation_correction.still_missing: no measured target engagement, no genetic-perturbation reference

results.units: well pairs on the 351-pair random-combination plates

limitations: Only two layout clusters (three cells each), so the cluster bootstrap is a range, not a reliable interval.
Annotation-level target overlap is not measured engagement, not a genetic-perturbation reference, not a mechanism claim.
Interaction types are pooled; two drugs sharing a gene may act in opposite directions.
The first attempt used the validation-plate design and had only 3 shared-target units; it is preserved as E018_RESULTS.json and is underpowered, not negative.
